Finance Officer Job at DAG Industries Nigeria Limited




        
    

        
        DAG Industries Nigeria Limited is an authorized distributor of Bajaj Auto Ltd. and MRF Tyres in Nigeria, with operations spanning motorcycles, tricycles, tyres, genuine spare parts, lubricants, and after-sales services.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Finance Officer
Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	Maintain accurate financial records and accounting documentation.
	Prepare invoices, payment schedules, reconciliations, and financial reports.
	Monitor receivables, payables, expenses, and cash transactions.
	Perform bank and general ledger reconciliations.
	Support budgeting, financial analysis, and month-end closing activities.
	Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax requirements, and company policies.
	Liaise with internal departments and external stakeholders on finance-related matters.


Requirements


	Bachelor's degree/HND in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
	2–4 years of relevant finance/accounting experience.
	Professional accounting qualification or relevant certification is an added advantage.
	Experience in FMCG, Automotive, or Manufacturing will be highly preferred.
	Good knowledge of accounting principles, reconciliations, and financial reporting.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting software.
	Strong attention to detail, analytical ability, and integrity.


Salary
N400,000 - N500,000 monthly.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their updated CV to: [email protected] using "Account Officer" as the subject of the email.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

	Coordinate travel arrangements and executive engagements.
	Track tasks, deadlines, and action points.
	Maintain confidential records and support effective communication across departments.

	Strong organisational, communication, and time-management skills.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and other productivity tools.
	Excellent attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.
	Ability to multitask, prioritise, and work with minimal supervision.
	High level of professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality.
	Previous experience in executive or administrative support is an added advantage.

Human Resource Volunteer Job at STSI




        
    

        
        STSI is a non-profit, non-governmental organisation established in 2016 and committed to improving the welfare, protection, and socio-economic wellbeing of vulnerable populations affected by armed conflict and extreme poverty. Its work focuses on children, young persons, women, and other at-risk groups across underserved communities in Nigeria. It is registered with the Corporate Affairs Commission under registration CAC/IT/NO 139240

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Human Resource Volunteer

Job Location: Maiduguri, Borno
Employment Type: Volunteer (unpaid)
Duration: Six (6) months with possibility of extension
Reports to: M&E Officer
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    



Key Responsibilities


	Support recruitment, including job adverts, shortlisting and scheduling interviews.
	Maintain staff and volunteer files, attendance registers and leave trackers.
	Assist with onboarding and orientation of new staff and volunteers.
	Support the filing and updating of HR policies and documents.


Qualifications


	OND/HND/B.Sc. in Human Resource Management, Business Administration, Social Sciences or a related field.
	Good organizational skills and the ability to handle confidential information.


General Requirements:


	Must be a resident of Borno State.
	Fluency in English; ability to speak Hausa and/or Kanuri is required for WASH, Protection and Nutrition roles.
	Basic computer skills (Microsoft Word, Excel and email).
	Willingness to work in communities and IDP camps when required.
	Good interpersonal and communication skills, and the ability to work in a team.
	Understanding of humanitarian principles is an advantage.
	Fresh graduates and NYSC members are encouraged to apply. Previous volunteer or field experience is an added advantage.


What We Offer


	Hands-on experience in humanitarian and development programming.
	On-the-job training, mentoring and capacity building.
	The opportunity to contribute to meaningful change in vulnerable communities.


Safeguarding and Equal Opportunity:


	STSI is committed to safeguarding the people we work with and has zero tolerance for sexual exploitation, abuse and harassment. Selected candidates will be expected to sign and abide by STSI's Code of Conduct and Safeguarding Policy, and reference checks will be carried out.
	STSI is an equal opportunity organization. Women and persons with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.


Fraud Notice:


	STSI does not charge any fee at any stage of the recruitment process (application, interview, training or placement). Anyone requesting payment in STSI's name should be reported to [email protected]


Note


	These are unpaid volunteer positions.
	A stipend may be considered when funded projects become available.
	Applicants will be asked to upload a CV (maximum 2 pages) and provide contact details of at least one referee.
	 Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, so early application is encouraged.

	Adherence to customer service standards

	Determining training needs
	Acting as a catalyst for change and improvement in performance and quality
	Recording, analyzing and distributing statistical information
